notes.title: February Love Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🤍LOVE IS IN THE AIR🤍[/h1]
[h3](for a limited time)[/h3]
[h2]Get cosy[/h2]
Our February update comes with some beautiful changes to the Zoo. 
The Karma hearts will be red and if you take a closer look around, you'll see all kinds of pretty decor.
It's the time of [b]love and cooperation[/b]. New Blobs are especially welcome to try out the game and teams with newcomers will profit even more than before!
On top of that we added KarmaZoo community items to Steam as well so now you can collect cards, decor your profile with backgrounds and show your love with cute emotes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/49b0bc1825dfa22b6cf0e6de4708f42b4db93ae6.gif[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*]🐌 Introducing the [b]Snail Sherpa![/b]
[*]💗[b] Beginner Blobs[/b] will now (and forever) give [b]5[/b] instead of [b]2[/b] Karma to others
[*]💋 [b] Karma Kiss [/b]gives[b] 2[/b] Karma instead of [b]1[/b] during the event
[*]⭐ +X% bonus on Karma when reaching the Karma Tree with a smaller number of people.
[b]Perfect for a romantic Zoo date[/b] of 2 or 3 or more...
(X goes from 50% when there is only 2 players down to 0% when the game is full)[/list][h1]SNAIL SHERPA[/h1]
[list][*][b]Time Freeze[/b] Slows down time ⏱️
[*][b]Karma Boost[/b] Boosts targeted characters by decreasing the Karma Kiss cooldown 💋
[*][b]Karma Zone[/b] Creates a zone in which each Karma Heart that goes through will be doubled 🤍🤍[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/c08b52f70ffe117b400f5137e37338dd24be6fd8.gif[/img]
[h1]COMMUNITY ITEMS[/h1]
We added emotes, backgrounds, cards and cool badges for you to collect!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/a376d034515509f026d72d6db32acf49440680c0.png[/img]
[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[i]v.1.05.010 --> v.1.06.002 [/i]

[b]GENERAL[/b]
St Valentine's & Lunar New Year Event
[list][*]Love is in the air! KarmaZoo's blossoms into the month of celebrating love. Enjoy the skin of love and lights while it lasts!
[*]Karma Kisses are juicier so share with your teammates at will!
[*]All 2 player games see their score boosted! Share good times with your partner.
[*]Unlock the exclusive Snail Sherpa with its love boosting ability and time controlling powers!
[/list][b]LOOP[/b]
[i]Fixed[/i]
[list][*]Clover bonus cards only appear when a Clover is in the group
[*]Accessibility: Background Density now shows Peacock Sherpa Feedback correctly
[*]Overall code stability to prevent multiple crashes 
[*]Minor bugfixes including Karma scoring and saving
[/list][i]Improved[/i]
[list][*]Newcomers give more Karma Hearts (up to 5) when helped by other players
[*]Bonus Perks effects' feedback and balancing
[/list]
If you need more information, want to chat to others of our super wholesome and active community, 
click the banner to join our Discord! 

[url=www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]

xoxo Pastagames

notes.title: Improvements & Patch notes 🔔
notes.notes:
[h1]KarmaZoo Patch 1[/h1]

It's been a wild ride so far and we were busy reading your feedback, fixing bugs and improving the game as much as we can. This couldn't be possible without your help!

Below you'll see a list of [b]patch notes![/b]
We hope you continue to enjoy the game and earn more Karma together.
Thank you so much for anyone leaving a positive review as well, it really helps us a lot! 
[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[i]version number: 1.05.015[/i]

These patch notes contain the major changes made since the game release on November 14, 2023, [i]version 1.04.010[/i]
[h2]Many bugs, exploits and some crashes fixed[/h2]
[list][*]related to characters' abilities and missions
[*]related to the bonus cards
[*]related to the Sanctuary
[*]related to streaming options
[*]disconnections not handled properly every time
[*]stronger anti-cheat system
[*]level design (cameras, respawn positions, blockers, ...)
[*]texts display from other alphabets than the selected one
[*]tutorial robot behavior
[/list][h2]Better Balance[/h2]
[list][*]some telescope missions' difficulty
[*]some exploits that were generating too much Karma for the party

[/list] Overall, the game is now more stable and has no more known major issues or exploits remaining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/63511e5f2f7d0908a6d54ea43eafbb9d8d3361c8.png[/img]

For more detailed Patch notes or If you need more information, want to chat to others of our super wholesome and active community, join our Discord! There's giveaways, 
game lore and a lot of other players. 

[url=www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]

xoxo Pastagames

notes.title: KarmaZoo is out NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Today is THE day![/h1]

We are so thrilled to finally have the chance to jump, sing and play in the Zoo with all of you.
This project is close to our hearts and a love letter to what cooperation can be in online games.
Share the love and die trying but never stop screaming.
[previewyoutube=nEJJgcrtJR4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What happens in the Loop?[/h2]
[list]
[*]Unlock 50 different characters with their own special abilities
[*]Explore a ton of handmade levels
[*]No two runs are ever the same
Your character & bonus choice and the size of your team will change everything
[*]Find new ways to connect and communicate with others
[*]Play with up to 10 random players or your friends!
[/list]
This wholesome platformer is all about finding bliss in cooperation, 
even when things go wrong. Use your voice and your abilities to help 
the team through the Loop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/c59463571ecb2076211ce2ec89fba24ec89ab872.gif[/img]

Don't forget to stay together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/62d75d9b9a3cae330e927955b5e4fa3968c795f0.gif[/img]

[h2]KarmaPass[/h2]
Together we will all unlock more characters in the future with the brilliant [url=https://www.karmazoogame.com/]KarmaPass[/url] 
It is totally free and all you have to do is play KarmaZoo. No matter where 
you are you will contribute to the Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/1bba1a54110deef4d2fe820841b3a0cc40b4f2fa.gif[/img]

[h2]Totem[/h2]
Enough cooperation? In the Totem Versus mode, players compete against 
each other in frantic quickfire tournaments, with friends online, in local couch play, 
or both at once. Players choose their Totem challenges from a variety of minigames, 
from goofy collect-em-alls, to hectic races of all shapes and colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/83980fdbfc0ab67a9c911f392cb97f1e4e401dcb.gif[/img]

If you need more information, want to chat to others of our super wholesome and 
active community, join our Discord! There's giveaways, 
game lore and a lot of other players. 

[url=www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]

Let's start sending and earning that precious Karma.
Have fun, Blobs!
xoxo Pastagames

notes.title: Introducing the (free) KarmaPass
notes.notes:
Dear Blobs,

You’ve probably heard of Battle Passes but we’re introducing something way better:
The (absolutely free) [b]KarmaPass[/b]

Use your unique abilities and combine them with other players in this cooperative platformer for up-to 
10 players. The goal? Spreading love, receiving and sending precious Karma!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/1bba1a54110deef4d2fe820841b3a0cc40b4f2fa.gif[/img]

You will all (everyone on this planet who plays the game) collectively work together through simply playing KarmaZoo. That’s the Karma Pass. It’s a free, community-driven evolution of the mean ol’ Battle Pass.

As you earn Karma, you will unlock new characters and upgrades. No matter your platform, you contribute to the KarmaPass as you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/8892fd3b8c691c4efb61cd56a28787a5f6d01787.gif[/img]

Now we’re very close to launch now with KarmaZoo coming out on November 14 and we can’t wait for you to play and explore all the fantastic worlds of the Zoo.

You can pre-order the game already or wishlist it, it supports us a lot!
If you need more information, want to chat to others of our super wholesome and active community, join our Discord! There's giveaways, game lore and a lot of other players. 

[url=www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/e2512487700d7cdf343945c43efa2f7301714daa.gif[/img]

We can't wait for you to start collecting Karma all together.
See you in the Zoo,
xoxo Pastagames

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Stream
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome to the Zoo, little Blobs![/h3]
Play KarmaZoo from the
[h2]9th - 16th of October[/h2]
KarmaZoo is an altruistic platformer all about cooperation for 2-10 players. Every single thing you do contributes to the greater good and helps your team receive sweet Karma! Solving puzzles, opening doors, exploring new levels - 300 handcrafted worlds will be picked depending on your team size, your abilities and the bonuses you choose.
Keep in mind - this Demo is just a snippet of what you can expect when KarmaZoo launches, there's a lot more to come. The progress you make will be carried over to the full game!

[h1]25% Pre-Order Discount[/h1]
On top of the Demo we're offering you a cheeky 25% Discount pre-ordering the game now! That means you'll have your Zoo ticket ready to go when the game launches on November 14.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/5faa8d6d147e586b7cb7f93638e6ef572ddd74c8.gif[/img]

Choose one of them or all of them to try out the Loop and see for yourself how you like to help your fellow team mates. Shine a light, hover in the air, be super quick, lift others up, and lots more...

[*]Spring

notes.title: KarmaZoo Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]We have a DATE!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/a24e2f2f0406a9af9b2b2e57133e41e8d1833d18.gif[/img]
KarmaZoo will launch on
[h2]November 14, 2023[/h2]
And we can't wait for you to hop into the [b]Loop mode[/b]!

[list]
[*] 300 handcrafted levels
[*] 50 characters with special abilities
[*] Puzzles, secrets, the challenge to stay together
[/list]
This altruistic platformer from [b]2-10 players[/b] invites you to navigate with true cooperation.
Change the way you travel through levels with your abilities, use everybody's strength to your team's adventage and find your way together. Every Loop is different, the way your level is picked depends on your team size, your abilities and the bonuses you choose.
KarmaZoo comes in [b]22 languages[/b] and crossplay for PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox S/X and PlayStation 5!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/62d75d9b9a3cae330e927955b5e4fa3968c795f0.gif[/img]
Don't lose your team or you'll vanish! Stay in your Halo, help each other out and be kind towards 
friends or random players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/e2512487700d7cdf343945c43efa2f7301714daa.gif[/img]
Work together and use your abilities to help the team through a level. 
Sweet Karma guaranteed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/372b59817a5ebfb53c433b3ad5dad5d95c915594.gif[/img]
Feeling more competitive than cooperative today? Hop on to our [b]Totem mode[/b].
KarmaZoo also comes with a local multiplayer mini game competition. Compete to reach the top of the Totem. A new spirit to the abilities that were designed for doing good.

[url=http://www.discord.gg/KarmaZoo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/720d603b0ae520825e7dbd87cb4ad34cba6cb22f.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for your support, Blobs.
We really appreciate it.
xoxo Pastagames

The size of your team, the characters and perks you choose will all determine your next level. Every character comes with their own ability, wanna play as an Umbrella to protect your team? Or be a super strong elephant paving the way for others? It's up to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989590/7673ff368dcf9c1b84cd7f496f2e461077984993.gif[/img]

Thank youuuu and see you on Thursday!
